ranked.headline: Curated cancer omics databases and fusion and methylation tools refine tumor interpretation
ranked.summary: NAR database updates (RNAactDrug 2.0, LncRNAfunc 2.0, R-loopBase v2.0, iGPSC-DB) land alongside new fusion, chimeric RNA and methylation-based cancer tools.

ranked.headline: Single-cell foundation models face attribution audits and simple-baseline benchmarks
ranked.summary: New preprints probe what scGPT, Cell2Sentence and STATE learn and benchmark five single-cell foundation models against simple baselines.

ranked.headline: Graph and latent models predict cancer survival and drug response from incomplete omics
ranked.summary: New TCGA-based methods address missing modalities, single-omic inputs, bulk deconvolution and cell-line-to-tumour transfer for oncology endpoints.

ranked.headline: Optimal transport and reference integration sharpen cell attribution in spatial omics
ranked.summary: New OT-based segmentation and deconvolution tools (Tracel, spOT-NMF) plus SWIMR and ARCADE target how spatial counts map to cells, types and states.

ranked.headline: Deep models translate across omics layers and read chromatin contact maps natively
ranked.summary: New models infer proteins, isoforms, chromatin and transcriptomes from partial omics, while Hi-C methods drop imputation and cut parameters.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and resampling-based nulls tighten calibration of inference in compositional omics
ranked.summary: Seven items pair benchmarks of confounder-aware abundance and composition tests with new null models and compositional frameworks for omics inference.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence models extend to nucleic acids and ligands, while benchmarks expose generalization gaps
ranked.summary: New benchmarks on MET kinase inhibitors and protein-RNA interfaces test whether pretrained sequence and structure models generalize beyond their training distributions.

ranked.headline: Controlled benchmarks expose where molecular ML gains hold, from ADMET to docking to generators
ranked.summary: New benchmarks and ablations test molecular ML under controlled splits, baselines and multi-stage filters, showing that representation choice and training gains are conditional.

ranked.headline: Sequence models, eQTL catalogs and functional atlases sharpen noncoding variant-to-gene prioritization
ranked.summary: New eQTL catalogs, imputation panels and sequence-model scores expand diverse-population coverage and improve noncoding variant prioritization.

ranked.headline: Foundation models are being pretrained on raw or minimally processed biological data, skipping intermediate summaries
ranked.summary: Recent preprints push foundation models toward raw reads, signals and fused modalities, bypassing count matrices, basecalls and separate-modality pipelines.

ranked.headline: Ground-truth benchmarks compare DIA search, quantification and postprocessing workflows across platforms
ranked.summary: Five studies benchmark DIA workflows on spike-ins, controlled mixtures, plasma and cardiovascular samples, plus a downstream analysis tool for quantitative proteomics.

ranked.headline: Regulatory network inference shifts toward perturbation, temporal and circadian structure
ranked.summary: New preprints and papers tie GRN inference to perturbation paths, temporal embeddings and circadian data, with a simulator and database supporting benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Tools couple biological networks and annotations to omics data in containers, visualization and GO reduction
ranked.summary: Three preprints extend Bioconductor containers, network visualization and GO term reduction to handle networks and annotations alongside omics data.

ranked.headline: Annotation-free detection of recurrent genomic elements and curated replication-origin resources
ranked.summary: Tools that find array-associated loci directly from raw DNA, alongside an expanded origin database, reflect a move toward annotation-independent genome mining.

ranked.headline: Bacterial genotype-to-function mapping advances via CRISPRi, structure, coevolution and metabolic models
ranked.summary: New bacterial studies pair genetic interaction screens, structure- and coevolution-based annotation, and ML-parameterized metabolic models to map function at genome scale.

ranked.headline: Agentic LLM analysis in biology is being paired with benchmarks and truth-based validation
ranked.summary: Five preprints pair LLM agent scaffolding with benchmarks and ground-truth testing for biological analysis, from variant reinterpretation to clinical sequencing.

ranked.headline: Tools assign reads and signals to specific isoforms across short-read, long-read, proteomic and single-cell data
ranked.summary: New tools address isoform ambiguity from quantification and read cleanup through annotation, event calling and proteogenomic validation, with atlas-scale resources.

ranked.headline: Tools quantify spatial and single-molecule signals while testing what dynamical models identify
ranked.summary: Six preprints pair finer spatial and molecular quantification with explicit tests of what temporal and operator models can identify from snapshot data.

ranked.headline: Workflows, portals and knowledge networks standardize reuse of spatial and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Six items build reproducible workflows, curated resources and portals for spatial and single-cell data, from HuBMAP's 9,316 datasets to traceable curation.

ranked.headline: Models reconstruct continuous cell dynamics and clonal fate from static single-cell and spatial snapshots
ranked.summary: Seven preprints this week extend snapshot single-cell and spatial data to continuous trajectories, clonal fate and interactions, using OT, bridges and generative models.

ranked.headline: Moss genomics and algal phylogenomics probe the origins of land plant lineages
ranked.summary: New moss genome and sex-chromosome preprints pair with a phylogenomic study of land plant algal relatives.

ranked.headline: Long reads and pangenome references reshape somatic variant detection in tumors
ranked.summary: Matched tumor-normal long-read sequencing and pangenome graphs are now benchmarked and used to call somatic SNVs and SVs directly.

ranked.headline: Gut microbiome databases link microbial features to host disease across cohorts
ranked.summary: Recent releases consolidate large human gut microbiome and gut disease datasets into reusable public resources.

ranked.headline: Leakage-controlled benchmarks reveal task dependence in protein language model evaluation
ranked.summary: Protein language models are being evaluated under leakage-controlled splits, exposing homology confounds across variant, epitope, and interaction tasks.

ranked.headline: Dynamics and large-scale checks expose limits of static protein design predictions
ranked.summary: Static structure predictions and sequence designs are now tested against dynamics, substrate scope, and proteome-wide recoding.

ranked.headline: Sequencing-based mapping of translation starts, transcript 3' ends, and ribosome occupancy
ranked.summary: Genome-wide readouts of translation start sites, transcript 3' ends, and translation efficiency are now paired with predictive and analysis tools for transcript-level work.

ranked.headline: Genomic language models and simplified workflows advance microbial sequence typing
ranked.summary: Growing public metagenomic and sequencing data motivate rapid computational and wet-lab methods for classifying microbial sequences.

ranked.headline: Sequence models predict cell-type and single-molecule regulatory activity from DNA
ranked.summary: Recent sequence-based models extend regulatory variant prediction to single-molecule chromatin, DNA methylation, and cell-type-specific expression.

ranked.headline: Correcting covariate and confounder bias in genomic association analyses
ranked.summary: Recent methods address collider bias, medication confounding, LD reference mismatch, and replicability within association workflows.

ranked.headline: Efficiency-focused algorithms replace dense computation in sequence analysis tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report large runtime and memory gains for sequence and single-cell tools, including brisc completing a 10M-cell workflow in 3 minutes.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links gene copy number and selection to insect and dog traits
ranked.summary: Genome-scale sampling across 275 insect genomes and two canine datasets now allows direct tests of selection and receptor diversity.

ranked.headline: Mixture and learned components capture heterogeneity in stochastic disease models
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs mixture, learned, and PINN-based components with stochastic and ODE models to represent subpopulation variation.

ranked.headline: Validating and scoring deep-learning RNA and protein-RNA structure predictions
ranked.summary: AlphaFold 3 fold and interface accuracy drop on novel RNAs, alongside new validation and confidence scores extended to nucleic acid complexes.

ranked.headline: Curated microbial genomics resources link sequences to ecology and metabolic traits
ranked.summary: Expanding genome-scale and metagenome-derived collections now enable strain-level profiling and trait inference across food, soil, and gut microbiomes.

ranked.headline: Fragment-ion evidence limits de novo peptide sequencing and PTM localization
ranked.summary: Eight deep learning de novo models share errors from limited fragment coverage, as new tools shift toward constraining search and localization.

ranked.headline: Upstream software tools gate reproducible inputs for computational biology analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a proteomics paper package input validation and preprocessing as installable, reproducible steps upstream of analysis.

ranked.headline: Generative and stochastic models capture protein conformational ensembles and dynamics
ranked.summary: Ensemble generators and reduced dynamical operators are being tested against SAXS and MD-derived backbone statistics.

ranked.headline: Predictive accuracy versus mechanistic correspondence in neural and fMRI models
ranked.summary: New fMRI benchmarks and linear-versus-nonlinear comparisons test whether predictive gains reflect underlying neural mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Differentiable and statistical models replace sequential cryo-EM density steps
ranked.summary: Joint, differentiable, and statistically defined density methods now address noisy cryo-EM and cryo-ET data across tasks from reconstruction to picking.

ranked.headline: Polymer and generative models infer hidden rules of 3D genome folding
ranked.summary: Polymer and generative models now recover hidden organizing rules, from cohesin kinetics to mitotic memory, directly from chromosome structure.
